field_text_formatted.value: If you're running Field Tokens as well, this connects to something I fixed there too. The [formatted_field-*] integration, which lets a token render a field through one of these formatters, broke during Field Tokens' own Drupal 8 port and stayed broken for years. 2.0.0 rebuilt that data provider from scratch, so whatever you build here, settings included, is reachable from a token again.
